description: Adds a booking the owner took by phone, as a walk-in or themselves: service, start, customer details; series repeats it weekly; resource picks staff or a room. A clash returns a 409 with the clashes (force books anyway). When it would email the customer, the first call returns confirm_token.

answers.description: {question id: answer} for the settings' questions ("" removes one)

confirm_token.description: From the first call, after the user's yes

notify_customer.description: Email the customer (default true when there is an email)

resource.description: Staff or room id or name (default any free)

series.description: Weekly repeat: count or until (YYYY-MM-DD); on_clash "skip" leaves out the dates that clash

name: add_booking
title: Add a booking
